shortDescription: Configures a user's role in a database.

options.name: role
options.description: The database role for the user to be modified. B(Deprecated:) This parameter is deprecated and will be removed in version 3.0.0. Use I(roles) instead.

options.name: roles
options.description: A dictionary of roles to manage for the user. Supports three keys C(add), C(remove), and C(set). C(add) adds the user to the specified roles. An empty list is a no-op and returns current membership. C(remove) removes the user from the specified roles. An empty list is a no-op and returns current membership. C(set) replaces all current roles with the specified roles. An empty list removes all role memberships. C(set) cannot be combined with C(add) or C(remove). At least one key must be present.

options.name: sql_instance
options.description: The SQL Server instance to modify.

options.name: state
options.description: Desired state of the user role membership. Only applicable when using the I(role) parameter (legacy mode). Cannot be used with I(roles).
